title: Hands To Yourself
description: Controls how your hand and camera overlays visible
body:
# Hands To Yourself
Hands To Yourself separates your hand and camera overlays (like vingette) to not be hidden from the "Toggle GUI" (F1) button and make them as their own buttons. Great for making first person cinematic shots!

![Keybinds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7b773191a9ad06e3fcc4845cfb7c502e90a39696.png)

F7 - Show/hide camera overlays

F8 - Show/hide hand

![Feature](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9spp6vde/images/bc571fef820eb5240334d7487cf93beba5d59a82_350.webp)
